items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know good and well that if there was something, even if it was a matter of being coy, I mean Phil Moore once wrote a song for her called I Feel So Smoochy.

ctx.x: You said working with Lena was a learning experience. Exactly what did you learn?

Okay, what I learned was more about the expression of, the primary expression, the one-to-one expression, this thing that I'm talking about that is basically human and happens to be prevalent and gets out through black people more because of the locale, which she would bring to it in a and with and cloaked through a kind of dramatic presence, a dramatic presentation that crystallized, was, that illuminated her, what she, message that she had to give to the audience. She was sensuous and she was angry and she was…
